name: ShengShou Lustrous Light-Up 3x3 (Magnetic) - Jelly Edition
description: The ShengShou Lustrous Light-Up 3x3 (Magnetic) - Jelly Edition is a magnetic speed cube built to be looked at. Clear jelly plastic shows off the candy-colored pieces inside, and a built-in rechargeable light makes the whole cube glow in the dark when you flip a hidden switch. Under the light show is a real magnetic 3x3 with 48 factory-installed magnets for fast, accurate turning.
features: Glows in the dark: a built-in light lights up the clear tiles in multiple colors, so the cube turns into a small light display when the room goes dark.
See-through jelly look: the transparent shell puts the internal pieces and magnets on full view, which is half the fun of this one.
Magnetic where it counts: 48 magnets give the satisfying click and snap-to-place feel that a plain non-magnetic cube can't.
No batteries to buy: the light runs off a built-in rechargeable battery you top up over USB.
Safe travels: it ships with a hard plastic case, so you can solve while you travel, safely.
48-magnet system: positioning slots and pillar supports hold every magnet firmly in place, so the feel stays consistent solve after solve.
